context: Walk Her Home: to her building.

lines.speaker: npc.club_waitress
lines.text: Car slowed down back there. Did you see?

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: New Jersey plates, KXR, something. He saw me read it. He drove on.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Goodnight. Lock the door. Count your money in the morning.
